annotations.title: Latest posts of a public Telegram channel (text, date, views, link)

description:
Latest posts of a public Telegram channel (text, date, views, link). Reads the public web preview t.me/s/<channel> (no login): newest `limit` posts (default 20, max 50) with id, date, text (HTML stripped, emoji kept), views, link, media types and channel title/subscribers. Channels without a public preview or that do not exist -> 404 (not settled). Cached 2 min.

GET /tg/channel/latest — price $0.004 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

channel.description: Public Telegram channel username (5-32 chars; '@name' or a t.me link also accepted), e.g. markettwits
